query.commandtext: UPDATE TQC_NOTICE_BOARD SET TITLE_KOR = :TITLE_KOR, TITLE_CHN = :TITLE_CHN, TITLE_ENG = :TITLE_ENG, BODY_KOR = :BODY_KOR, BODY_CHN = :BODY_CHN, BODY_ENG = :BODY_ENG, NOTICE_START = TO_DATE(:NOTICE_START, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), NOTICE_END = TO_DATE(:NOTICE_END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), USE_FLAG = :USE_FLAG, UPDATE_USER_ID = :USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE NOTICE_SEQ = :NOTICE_SEQ

SELECT NOTICE_SEQ, CASE :LANG WHEN '0' THEN NVL(TITLE_ENG, NVL(TITLE_KOR, TITLE_CHN)) WHEN '1' THEN NVL(TITLE_KOR, NVL(TITLE_ENG, TITLE_CHN)) WHEN '2' THEN NVL(TITLE_CHN, NVL(TITLE_KOR, TITLE_ENG)) END TITLE, CASE :LANG WHEN '0' THEN NVL(BODY_ENG, NVL(BODY_KOR, BODY_ENG)) WHEN '1' THEN NVL(BODY_KOR, NVL(BODY_ENG, BODY_CHN)) WHEN '2' THEN NVL(BODY_CHN, NVL(BODY_KOR, BODY_CHN)) END "BODY", TO_CHAR(NOTICE_START, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(NOTICE_END, 'YYYY-MM-DD') "DATE" FROM ( SELECT * FROM TQC_NOTICE_BOARD WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN NOTICE_START AND NOTICE_END AND USE_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY NOTICE_SEQ DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

INSERT INTO TQC_NOTICE_BOARD ( NOTICE_SEQ, TITLE_KOR, TITLE_CHN, TITLE_ENG, BODY_KOR, BODY_CHN, BODY_ENG, NOTICE_START, NOTICE_END, USE_FLAG, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_TIME ) VALUES ( NOTICE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, :TITLE_KOR, :TITLE_CHN, :TITLE_ENG, :BODY_KOR, :BODY_CHN, :BODY_ENG, TO_DATE(:NOTICE_START, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(:NOTICE_END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), :USE_FLAG, :CREATE_USER_ID, SYSDATE )

SELECT NOTICE_SEQ, TO_CHAR(NOTICE_START, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') NOTICE_START, TO_CHAR(NOTICE_END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') NOTICE_END, USE_FLAG, TITLE_KOR, TITLE_CHN, TITLE_ENG, BODY_KOR, BODY_CHN, BODY_ENG, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER_ID, UPDATE_TIME FROM TQC_NOTICE_BOARD WHERE (NOTICE_START BETWEEN TO_DATE(:FROM_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:TO_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) OR (NOTICE_END BETWEEN TO_DATE(:FROM_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:TO_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))
